predecessor.relation: DISTINCT_CONVERSE_PROXY_FAILURE: C006 proves full image does not force selected-point differential surjectivity; C007 proves selected-point differential surjectivity at a singular source does not force full image.

attempted_implication: For a proper morphism pi:W->H into an irreducible target, surjectivity of d pi_w on Zariski tangent spaces at one selected incidence point implies pi(W)=H.
exact_result_or_failure: Let W=V(y^2-x^3) be the reduced irreducible cusp and let pi:W->A^2_C be the closed immersion. Since d(y^2-x^3)_0=0, T_0 W = T_0 A^2_C and d pi_0 is surjective. Nevertheless pi(W) is the proper closed subset W, not all A^2_C. Raw tangent surjectivity at a singular source is therefore insufficient for image coverage.

attached_sufficient_certificate.statement: If pi:W->H is proper, H is irreducible, and pi is smooth at some w in W, then pi(W)=H.
attached_sufficient_certificate.proof: Smoothness holds on a source neighborhood U of w and smooth morphisms are open, so pi(U) contains a nonempty open subset of H. Properness makes pi(W) closed. A closed subset of irreducible H containing a nonempty open is H.

seven_field_math_lesson.attempted_implication: Surjective d pi_w at a selected witness-incidence point implies that the actual image covers the target Hodge component.
seven_field_math_lesson.exact_result_or_failure: The cusp closed immersion has a surjective tangent map at its singular origin but a proper image; the implication fails even with reduced irreducible source, smooth irreducible target, and proper pi.
seven_field_math_lesson.supported_and_competing_causes: Supported cause: the singular source has excess Zariski tangent directions that need not integrate into actual motion. Properness is not the local cause and is retained as a separate whole-component guard. Target singularity is not needed; coefficient and formal/global Hodge obligations are applicability boundaries rather than causes of this counterexample.
seven_field_math_lesson.scope: Abstract finite-type complex algebraic morphisms and a pointwise tangent proxy. This is not an actual Hodge-incidence construction and does not prove initial algebraicity, exact signed-Q witness availability, all-order lifting, algebraization, monodromy, degeneration, or global continuation.
seven_field_math_lesson.falsifier: For target use, prove that the exact-class witness-incidence morphism is smooth at w and proper over one irreducible target component; then the cusp mechanism is inapplicable and the attached open-plus-closed certificate yields coverage.
seven_field_math_lesson.mathematical_repair: Replace raw tangent rank by smoothness at a suitable incidence point plus properness and component binding, or prove the actual image is closed and dominant/top-dimensional directly.
seven_field_math_lesson.proof_and_source_evidence: Direct cusp tangent/closed-immersion calculation; Stacks Project tags 056G for smooth morphisms being universally open, 01W6 for proper closed image, and 01W5 for closed immersions being proper.
